_comment: Which model provider each workload uses. Copy to llm-providers.json, or just
use the setup UI's AI models card, which writes this file for you.
NO SECRETS LIVE HERE. Provider and model ids only. API keys stay in .env,
which the litellm container alone reads — that is what keeps the gateway the
single point of egress and keeps every application container credential-free.
'default' is the provider every workload uses. 'preferred' is its model;
'fast' is the cheap one used by the five workloads that run a cheaper tier
intake-agent-haiku). Leave 'fast' out to use 'preferred' for everything —
which costs more, because those five were deliberately put on a cheap tier.
'overrides' repoints one workload at a different provider or model. Anything
Deleting this file is safe: the built-in defaults reproduce the configuration
this project shipped before providers were configurable.
